title: Dog Night, 2016 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The morning after seventeen years: the box under the table — the first dog's box from December 2014 — and the pup asleep against it, having found it in the night. Wood looks and doesn't move him. The panel is mostly the box.

panels.composition: The garage in morning light. A small cardboard box under the drafting table with the PUP asleep against it.
